implementation_decisions: post-PR-C implementation decisions (fixed before any T1-T8 result):
all signals use only marks and funding at or before the decision time; marks are the daily 00:00 UTC rows of the 1h dataset, funding is the funding_rate of due rows

T1: r30 and r90 are the past 30d and 90d simple returns of daily marks; s = 0.5*sign(r30) + 0.5*sign(r90); ann_vol is the annualized (sqrt 365) EWMA (halflife 60d, normalized weights, non-centered) daily-return vol with at least 30 returns; mu_i = 2 * s * (0.20 / ann_vol_i) * one_way_cost, where one_way_cost = fee + spread = 0.0007
T2: score = mark(t-1d)/mark(t-1d-90d) - 1 (a 90d return ending one day before the decision), demeaned across symbols and scaled so mean |mu| = 2*one_way_cost; an all-zero score gives mu = 0

T2 net exposure: the allocator has no net-exposure constraint, so |sum w| <= 0.05 is NOT enforced; the mu are demeaned only (declared deviation); gross is the allocator's 0.95 rather than the plan's 1.0
T3: mu_i = -(sum of funding_rate over due rows in (t-7d, t]) / 7, i.e. minus the trailing 7d mean funding rate per 24h

T4: Ridge alpha 10, 24h horizon, expanding window and 30-day refit as PR-C, on every dataset feature (1h__ non-funding, funding, 4h__ and 1d__); mu = 0 where a symbol's packet is unavailable (for example XRP 4h/1d features after the 2022 gap)

T5: LightGBM 24h on the PR-C 1h__ non-funding roster with 200 trees, max_depth 3, num_leaves 8, learning_rate 0.05, min_child_samples 200, reg_lambda 1, random_state 0, n_jobs 1; if lightgbm cannot be imported the trial is recorded FAILED_TO_RUN and nothing is substituted

T6: each component (Ridge24 as in PR-C, T1, T3), as a per-24h expected simple return, is divided by its causal trailing-365-day population std pooled over symbols and dates (dates up to and including the decision); the three are averaged and the average is multiplied by the causal trailing-365-day std of Ridge24 mu. T1/T3 histories start in the fit period; Ridge24 history can only start at the first vintage (2023-01-01), so mu = 0 until at least 10 daily Ridge24 dates exist. A symbol without a Ridge packet contributes 0 for that component

T7: T6 mu and, in the policy, scale = clip((0.20 - DD) / 0.10, 0, 1) with DD = 1 - equity / snapshot peak_value at each scheduled decision; once DD >= 20% the scale is latched at 0 until equity >= 0.95 * peak. The scale is applied as an exposure budget: if gross(target) > scale * gross_max the whole target is shrunk proportionally to scale * gross_max (hold-current-quantity flags are dropped for that decision); at scale 1 the allocator target is untouched. Consequence recognised before running: once latched the book is flat, equity cannot recover to 0.95*peak, so the latch is effectively terminal for the rest of the replay

T8: T6 with 168h decisions at Monday 00:00 UTC (decision_anchor_hour_utc = 96 hours since epoch modulo 168); the allocator covariance is built from weekly marks (warmup from the same fit period) and T6 mu, defined per 24h, is multiplied by 7 so it is an expected return over the decision interval

all eight trials are long/short, use the PR-C allocator parameters (gamma 5, halflife 60d, shrink 0.2, w_max 0.5, gross_max 0.95, min trade 0.5%), the PR-C execution costs, the three PR-C scenarios and the PR-C selection rule
candidate pool for selection = the three PR-C allocator arms plus T1-T8 (CASH and buy-and-hold are controls); the label is DEVELOPMENT_PROMISING or NO_WINNER, never WINNER
Bonferroni: confidence intervals are additionally reported at level 0.05/13 (5 PR-C arms plus 8 trials)
validity for a trial = real-data future-perturbation causality probe passed (per trial) and every replay reconciled against raw fills with a flat terminal book and no termination
a trial that raises is recorded with its error and counted as not eligible; nothing is substituted or retried with other parameters
registered_before: the PR-C result and every T1-T8 result
